lines.en: You know...I think I’ve killed enough time wandering around the forest.
I’ve gone fishing with Maki...I sat by the river with Yuki...I’ve even [[REDACTED] with Kaori and [[TEMPLATE9].
And in the event that Sara is still not done “bonding” with Ami, I’m just going to have to make her my temporary wife in order to reinsert myself into Ami’s day.
This trip was meant to strengthen our bond, after all. And as appreciative as I am to have someone like Sara who is going way out of her way to bring some maternal influence back into Ami’s life, I-
: Let me move in with you. Let me be her mom.
I suddenly remember that there is someone else I was supposed to give that role to.
I suddenly remember that I had the building blocks to form a real family firmly in my hands and all I’ve done with them is build another wall.
But this one was made specially for Niki — a girl I’ve known forever who wants nothing more than to be a bigger player in the game that I call life.
But for some reason, I still struggle with the thought of putting her through that.
I swear, this game would be so much easier if that family would just fuck off already.
: I’m back from where I was before.
: I feel like I literally just saw you.
: Yeah, same.
: I know I make things about myself a lot, but I just want to say I’m quite offended that you’ve hung out with literally everyone but me.
: Not everyone. I’ve still barely seen Sara and Ami. But, now that I mention it-
: Don’t worry. She’s not stealing her or trying to take your place or anything. I’m sure they’ll be done soon.
: But, then again, I could be wrong since I wasn’t allowed in there either.
: Probably because you would have made things weird and gotten some sort of animal penis involved.
: We’re in nature, Sensei. There are animal penises everywhere.
: I can’t make them any more involved than they already are.
: I don’t like the way you look at nature, Maki.
: Sara’s got some weird fuckin’ friends, huh?
: We weren’t always this bad. But things have really gone to shit over the last few years and now this is sort of just where we’re at.
: Wack. Feel like it’s the complete opposite for me.
: If you’re that worried, why not just head over to their tent? I feel like you could have been with them this entire time if you really wanted. Neither one of them is going to deny you.
: Wasn’t I kind of denied already? Like, the only reason I wandered around at all is because Sara made it sound like this was something only she and Ami were-
: What’s this about Sara and Ami?
: Oh, wow. That’s certainly a drastic change.
: That’s right! Surprise!
: You...cut that much off?...
: I kind of had to. Like, maybe I could have gotten away with leaving it a little longer. But it was so uneven that I figured it’d make the most sense to just completely clean it up and start fresh.
: But...
: Do you hate it?...
: I know you’ve always preferred longer hair, but...it’s like Sara said. It was just...too messed up to really save.
: It...It’ll grow back, though! So you only have to deal with having someone who looks more like a nephew for a little while and...I can wear even girlier clothes to try and make up for-
: No.
: I still think you’re adorable. It’s just...really different.
: Y...Yeah...
: I don’t even want to think of what the other girls will say if...any of them are still willing to talk to me.
: I know this isn’t the best time, but I’m going to need at least 8,000 yen for the haircut. You can just Venmo me if you don’t have cash.
: Sara...come on.
: Kidding, kidding. Your uncle’s given me more than enough money with all the booze he’s bought over the last few years. This is the least I can do.
: Which means, now it’s his turn!
: My turn to what?
: Spend some time with Ami, of course! That’s what you’ve been waiting for ever since we got here, is it not? Because I know for sure that’s what Ami’s been looking forward to.
: And now she gets to do that without feeling super self-conscious about the way she looks!

: I mean...don’t get me wrong...I think you did a great job, but...I wouldn’t say I’m not self-conscious anymore. This is the first time I’ve ever even had short hair. It’ll take a little while to...get used to.
: Sara...
: Sarasaki86.
: What?
: My Venmo name.
: I don’t even know what that is.
: Please forgive my uncle...he’s kind of illiterate when it comes to technology.
: And you’re kind of illiterate when it comes to literacy, but I love you anyway.
: You’re...saying that in front of other people now?!
: That was the single cutest thing I have ever heard come out of your mouth and I would like you to say it again right now.
: No.
: I’ll waive the haircut fee.
: I love you, Ami.
: Kyaaaah! My heart!
: I...love you too. More than anything in the whole wide world.
: That’s good to hear.
: I guess...shall we go for a walk then?
: Y...Yeah!
: Have fun, you two! But remember that there are bears around here!
: And remember that Maki is probably thinking about their penises!
: Well I am now. Thanks a lot, Haru-kun.
: Aight. That’s enough of this shit. I’m takin’ a smoke break.
: You’re literally smoking right now, Yuki.
: I can handle two at once.
: Ahh, another woman of culture.
: I’m more than content with one so long as it belongs to the man that I love.
: Can we...maybe start walking now? So we don’t have to listen to this anymore?...
: Yeah, I don’t want to be around another second of this either.
And so the two of us set off toward the middle of nowhere.
And we keep walking until the sun sets.
Ami fills me in on all of the things she talked about with Sara.
As you may have guessed, I was a hot topic when it came to conversation. But Ami assured me that she managed to keep her most impure feelings out of the equation for my sake.
And while that’s nice and all, I wish she’d keep them out of her head entirely as they’re going to be even less acceptable once I fit better into the role I was meant to inhabit years ago.
Which is great because after commanding me to cum inside of her probably over a hundred times now, I think it’s safe to say those feelings are pretty impure.
Such comments probably shouldn’t sprout up on a trip where I’ve pledged to become more of a father though.
A good father doesn’t cum inside his daughter. A good father cums on her face. Or into a ball of napkins she presses against the head of his cock when the time comes for him to let loose.
But again, that doesn’t matter right now.
I can’t avoid this any longer. And I certainly can’t afford to let her break again because she barely has any hair to cut off now and I’m worried about what she’d lose next.
I’m worried about a lot of things, really.
I’m worried about whether she even wants to look at me any differently than a worthless uncle she needs to take care of.
I’m worried about her feeling worthless in her own regard if I start to do more things around the house on my own.

I’m worried of whether or not her friends are still her friends or if she’ll need to find new ones. And I’m worried about whether she even wants friends in the first place when all she ever thinks about is me.
But most of all, I’m worried about her growing up.
Which is irrational given the type of world we live in, yes. And further exacerbated by the fact that I’ve been both subtly and not-so-subtly prompting her to grow up for years now.
Was all of that just me lying to myself?
Do I really want an Ami who can avoid clinging to me? Who lets me stay out late and do whatever I want without so much as a care in the world?
Or do I want someone who will keep me in her heart at all hours of the day?
Who will call me over and over and over again, hundreds or thousands of times until I’m feeling brave enough to pick up the phone.
Does the type of Ami I’ll have even matter? Or is it just her I want in general?
I have no way of knowing, really. And I think for a moment that this just might be what being a parent feels like.
But then I remember how it felt to be a child.
And how I’m probably just being delusional again.
: Do you believe in God, Sensei?
: Do you?
: I do.
: Maya makes fun of me for it sometimes, but I think that He’s real.
: I don’t know if He’s watching every second of every day, but I think He’s there.
: And I think that all of the suffering that you and I have endured is just His way of testing us.
: Testing us for what?
: To see if we are worthy of Heaven.
: To see if we can endure the harshness of reality and overcome adversity in order to gain one of the many limited seats in the giant sky castle all good boys and girls go to when they die.
: Adversity is a pretty big word for you, Ami.
: Well, God’s a pretty big thing. He deserves bigger words.
: To be honest, I don’t really know what I believe.
: I want to say I don’t. But sometimes I feel like that might just be me lying to myself since there’s rarely a time where things are going terribly that I’m not either blaming or talking to god God.
: I still instinctively want to pray when something bad happens. I just typically decide against it because it feels like...submitting.
: What’s wrong with submitting to something you believe in?
: The fact that I don’t know if I actually believe it. Because there’s a chance I only want to pray in the first place because I was conditioned to want that.

: If I’m conditioned to hug a teddy bear every time I’m feeling sad just because someone gave me one when I was little, does that make wanting to hug a teddy bear wrong now that I’m older and can buy my own?
: Not...necessarily.
: Also, is it just me, or have we had this conversation before?
: We’ve probably had it before.
: In fact, there are probably tons of conversations we’ve had before that we’re going to forget about and then have again.
: That’s kind of just what happens when you spend so much time with somebody, I think.
: Do you think our answers will ever change?
: I don’t think there’s anything off limits for change now that my hair is completely gone.
: The dark circles might take a little longer to get rid of, though. But Sara gave me a few tips on how to treat them.
: I don’t mind those sticking around. They make you look like a...cute zombie or something.
: I didn’t know you were into that sort of thing, Sensei.
: It was an earlier talking point.
: Besides, there are probably a lot of things you don’t know about me.
: Probably.
: And the same goes for me.
: But if there’s anything you ever want to know-
: Ami...am I on the right track right now?
: The right track? What do you mean?
: With this...parenting thing.
: Like, is this something you actually want? Or is it something I’ve just decided you need?
: I’ve been your uncle forever. You’ve been my niece forever. And I’ve been all sorts of fucked up lately, so it’s highly plausible that this is just some sort of delusion I cooked up and...
: And I don’t want to change anything if that’s going to fuck with your head since I know the two of us are pretty against change to begin with.
: Is it really changing anything, though?
: What do you mean?
: I mean...you basically are my dad already. I’ve just never really called you that outside of sex because I didn’t want to put any pressure on you.
: I mean...you basically are my dad already. I’ve just never really called you that because I didn’t want to put any pressure on you.
: Like, don’t get me wrong. I love things like this and nothing would make me happier than to experience more special outings with you to make more special memories, but...
: You don’t need to do this kind of stuff to make me look at you that way.
: You don’t need to change anything at all.
: You’re doing great.
: And I’m excited for you to keep being my dad for the rest of our lives.
: Is it...okay if I call you that now?...
: Yeah...
: Do you...
: Do you think my first dad would be okay with it?...
: Because I’ve tried asking him, but...I never really get a response.
: I have no idea...
: I think he would...
: And...besides-
: Besides! There’s always the chance that I could be, like...your actual daughter anyway, right?
: What?
: Like...I already know you loved my mom, so...
: It wouldn’t be crazy if you guys might have...you know...
: It wouldn’t be crazy if I was your real daughter anyway! Right?!
: Right?...
: Are...
: Is...everything okay?
: I just don’t really know what to say to that, Ami.
: Should I...not have said that?
: How long has that thought been in your head?
: Kind of...loooooong...
: And...that hasn’t changed the way you look at me?
: Honestly?...
: I think it makes it more exciting.
: And significantly less legal, probably.
: Oh, not at all.
: If anything, it just makes me want to carry your incest babies even more. And my hope in telling you this is that you will now revisit your stance when it comes to having sex with me.
: You think you being my actual daughter would increase the chance of that?
: I’ll take any chance I can get at this point.
: You know what? Let’s just...shelve that thought for now and...revisit it one day when I’m feeling a little less broken.
: Sure. Of course, if that’s what makes you happy.
: Can I...still call you Dad though?
: Yeah.
: Like...in front of other people, though?
: Wherever and whenever you want.
: And...you’re not worried about what they might think?
: You’re my number one priority now, Ami.
: Now?
: Did I say “now?” I meant “always.”
: Mhm. Nice cover.

: I just hope this doesn’t mean Ayane is going to try and call you Dad as well. She hates when I have things that she doesn’t and I’ve never once complained that her allegedly biological father is alive.
: I’m pretty sure Ayane’s father isn’t just “alleged,” Ami.
: I know that. But mine is and I’m trying to draw parallels here.
: Okay. I think that’s enough sitting around for now. Let’s head back to the camp.
: But Daaaaaaaaaad!
: You’re going to do that all the time now, aren’t you?
: Of course!
: I have to make up for lost time.

Congratulations! Your status effect [[PARANOID] has weakened!
Congratulations! You have earned the title [[(ALLEGED) DAUGHTER-FUCKER]!
Ami’s affection has increased by 10!
Things are finally starting to look up!
If only you would stop looking down.
Darkness falls several hours later.
Ami has run off somewhere and everyone else seems to be doing something.
What should I do?
Bond with Haruka
See what Nao is up to
Play games with Kaori
Call someone
Call it a night
